text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting Scarborough Community Council to approve the designation of a two-way centre left-turn only lane on Bridletowne Circle (northeast leg), between a point 57.5 metres north of Finch Avenue East and a point 54.5 metres east of Warden Avenue. Due to the existing wide lane widths and lane configuration on Bridletowne Circle (northeast leg), it is appropriate to narrow the lane widths and designate a two-way centre left-turn only lane, to allow left-turns into driveways on both sides of Bridletowne Circle (northeast leg). This safety and operational improvement would be completed in 2023 in conjunction with road resurfacing on Bridletowne Circle (northeast leg), from Finch Avenue East to Warden Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated a two-way centre left-turn only lane on Bridletowne Circle (northeast leg), between a point 57.5 metres north of Finch Avenue East and a point 54.5 metres east of Warden Avenue.
